track: Amazon KDD Cup 2024 Multi-Task Online Shopping
claim: 508 teams, 1499 entrants; ShopBench about 20,000 questions across 57 tasks; Phase 2 time limits 70/20/30/20/140 minutes across Tracks 1-5; code competition on 4x T4 16GB.
counter: AIcrowd page reports 1,862 users and 9,095 submissions while the institutional announcement reports 1,499 entrants. Both are shown; the team count agrees at 508 but the user count does not.
verdict_what: 只作规模分母；口径不同时必须注明来源，不能混用。

track: Amazon KDD Cup 2024 Shopping MMLU, Tracks 1-5
rank: 1st in all five tracks and overall; final scores 0.833/0.791/0.746/0.761/0.788
claim: Qwen2-72B-Instruct QLoRA on a self-built 502,435-example dataset assembled from public ecommerce datasets plus LLM synthetic examples; 4 adapters v7/v8/v7b/v9b ensembled with wise-ft; task-type system prompt and logits processors; AWQ 4-bit plus vLLM to fit 4x T4.
counter: Dual-adapter ensemble improved scores only 0.001-0.004; logits processors became less useful in phase 2 as models got larger. It is not a retrieval/RAG win in the conventional sense.
verdict_what: 借两件：公开数据反向构造成同格式训练集，以及 Logits Processors 式的输出格式硬约束。

track: Amazon KDD Cup 2024 Shopping MMLU, Tracks 1-5
claim: The paper abstract identifies three components: base model selection, pretrained model quantization, and prompt design. No deeper retrievable method detail was obtained.
counter: The OpenReview PDF was blocked by human verification, so the abstract is the only accessible method evidence. No claim about retrieval or reranking can be supported.
verdict_what: 仅记名次，不作方法借鉴。

track: TrustBit Enterprise RAG Challenge Round 1 and Round 2
claim: Public annual-report pool 7,496 files/about 46GB. Round 2 test used 100 reports and 100 questions, with 2.5 hours for parsing/ingestion. Answers require PDF SHA1 plus zero-based physical page index; score = G + R/3 (max 133.3).
counter: The public leaderboard includes experiments submitted after ground-truth release and is explicitly an unofficial overview. It should not be used as the official final ranking.
verdict_what: 只作赛道定义证据；R/G 分拆读法和页级引用 schema 是本仓最有用的参照。

rank: 1st on unofficial leaderboard: R 83.8 / G 81.8 / Score 123.7, 49 min
claim: Modified Docling parser preserving page references; recursive 300-token chunks with 50-token overlap and page-index metadata; separate FAISS IndexFlatIP database per company with text-embedding-3-large; top-30 chunks mapped back to full pages; GPT-4o-mini LLM reranking weighted 0.7 versus vector 0.3 and top-10 pages; company-name regex routing; answer-type-specific prompts; comparative questions decomposed into per-company subquestions; structured output with CoT and SO reparser.
counter: The winner abandoned table serialization in the final configuration because it reduced signal-to-noise; hybrid BM25+vector also did not improve in his implementation. These negative results are specific to his stack.
verdict_what: 抄路由到单文档/单公司、父页回链、LLM rerank、按答案类型路由提示、无据 N/A、指标兼容性 CoT 的完整组合。

claim: LLM_Search used query expansion, a cost-effective fast LLM to retrieve relevant pages, a powerful LLM to answer, and finalization. No vector embeddings or vector database.
counter: Without published prompts/code in the leaderboard excerpt, the detailed page-selection model and finalization rules cannot be reproduced exactly.
verdict_what: 证明在页级评分下向量不是必需；可借'扩写查询→快模型找页→强模型答→定稿'的低成本分层。

claim: No embeddings or vector database. Used SEC EDGAR ontologies for query expansion, dynamic structured output with CoT, CBOW similarity for majority selection across multiple runs, PDF-quality heuristics and synthetic tags to stabilize page detection.
counter: Ontology-specific to SEC filings; transfer to Chinese standards/statutes needs a comparable ontology and page-quality heuristics.
verdict_what: 本仓强本体场景值得抄 ontology 扩写与多次运行多数投票；页检测稳定化也值得借。

claim: For every question, all pages of the provided documents were fed to GPT-4o in the best experiment.
counter: It took 30 hours in the leaderboard time column and contradicts speed/cost constraints; not a scalable architecture.
verdict_what: 仅作反面参照：全页 brute force 能拿高 R，但成本不可接受。
